extracted.name: Black Walnut Ice Cream
extracted.description: My dad and I loved black walnut anything. Black walnuts taste very different than English walnuts so I created this one on his behalf. I like it best topped with caramel sauce or honey.
instruction_lines: Combine light cream, half-and-half, sugar, and black walnut extract.
Pour mixture into an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions, then fold in walnuts. Transfer to an airtight container and freeze until firm.
